description: HR-58 is the Regional Transport Authority (RTA) office based in Jagadhari, specifically designated for the registration of commercial and transport vehicles in the Yamuna Nagar district. While HR-02 serves private vehicles, this office manages heavy vehicles, taxis, and buses, ensuring regulatory compliance within this significant industrial and timber-trading hub of Haryana.
address: DTO/RTA Office, Old Court Premises, Jagadhari, Yamuna Nagar, Haryana
